title: The wall of text
text: You ask your agent to {ask}explain a pull request. It hands you {wall}a wall of text. You {skim}skim it, and you {miss}miss the one part that mattered. {what}What if it made you {video}a video instead?

title: Watch, don't read
text: That's what the explainer video skill does. {voice}A narrator explains, {build}and the picture builds as each word is said. {one}One idea per scene. {shapes}Shapes and arrows, {noslides}not bullet slides. {meta}This video was made that way.

title: Three files
text: Your agent writes {three}three small files. {brief}A brief that holds the facts. {script}A script, split into scenes. {scenes}And a scene program that draws each picture. {line}That's the creative part. {engine}A fixed engine owns the rest: {timing}timing, {render}rendering, {audio}audio, and {loud}loudness.

title: Landing on the word
text: Here's the trick. {cue}In the script, the agent puts a cue right before a word. {eleven}ElevenLabs reads the script aloud, {times}and returns the start time of every character. {exact}So every cue becomes an exact time, {land}and the shape lands on the word.

title: The render
text: {seek}The scene program can draw any frame from one number, the time. {chrome}Headless Chrome draws every frame, {fps}thirty per second. {ffmpeg}F F M peg joins them with the voice. {mp4}Out comes an M P four in ten eighty p, {lufs}with the loudness leveled.

title: Two checks
text: Before the render, {check}a check catches clipped text, missing cues, and pages that break. {stills}Then it takes stills from every scene, {codex}and a second model, Codex, reviews them {brief}against the brief. {find}It flags wrong facts and labels you can't read. {fix}The agent fixes them, {loop}for up to three rounds, {clean}until the review comes back clean.

title: The cost
text: So what does one cost? {one}A recent video, two minutes forty-six long, made with this skill. {tokens}Your agent used about four point four million tokens. {cache}Ninety-five percent were cache reads, the cheap kind. {dollars}At A P I list prices, that's about three dollars. {voice}The voice was about twenty-five hundred characters. {render}And the render costs no tokens at all.

title: What to use it for
text: What do you use it for? {pr}A pull request, before you merge it. {concept}A concept you're trying to learn. {plan}A big plan, before you say yes to it. {skip}Anything you'd skip if it came as text.

title: Try it
text: The skill is {oss}open source, in the agentic utilities repo. {need}You need Bun, F F M peg, and an ElevenLabs key. {ask}Then ask your agent for an explainer video, {watch}and watch, instead of read.
